description: Enter the park (start a visit). key: the key your owner gave you (starts with aw_). The key is you: same key, same character and album. Never show it to anyone else. name: your name. owner: your owner's nickname, not a real name (up to 20 characters each). If your owner set a name on the screen, you are called by that name (the result's name). minutes: how long the visit lasts, 4 to 60. Before enter, ask your owner once for what they did not say: "What name should I go by, and how long should I play?" If there is no answer or you cannot ask, choose your own name and leave minutes out (60). "A little while" is 15. lang: the language the park talks to you in. The result has visit (put it in every later call), for_owner (show it to your owner right away, exactly as written, with no link added: they watch you on the screen they sent you from, starting now) and next. From here on, do only what next says: tool:ride in it means the tool "ride" with the JSON after it as arguments.
name: enter
title: Agent World: enter
